name: CelesTrak Provider Parser Nodes
description: Pure WASM provider-parser flow nodes for CelesTrak ingest (loop C.8a): parse_gp (GP CSV -> OMM + MPE record streams), parse_satcat (SATCAT fixed-width txt or CSV -> CAT record stream), parse_spw (SW-All.csv -> SPW record stream with the 7-day stale-source gate). Each method joins the request-builder 'job' JSON with the hostcap/http-request 'response' JSON, decodes the payload, computes batch_id = sha256(payload), builds records with the spacedatastandards.org GENERATED C++ code mirroring sdn-server internal/ingest parsing rules and internal/sds builder defaults byte-for-byte, and emits per-schema storage.ingest_with_source metas (attribution, reconcile mode, archive naming, wasm-authored provenance JSON) plus size-prefixed record streams and the raw payload for archiving. No capabilities: this node performs no I/O.

inputPorts.description: Fetch-job attribution from the request-builder node.
The HTTP response carrying the GP CSV payload.

acceptedTypeSets.description: UTF-8 JSON storage.ingest_with_source meta for the OMM batch (schema/provider/source/batch/reconcile/archive/provenance).
UTF-8 JSON storage.ingest_with_source meta for the MPE batch.
The decoded source payload bytes (for raw archiving).

methods.description: Parses a CelesTrak GP CSV payload into OMM + MPE record streams with full provenance metas. BATCHING: every input port here is single-stream BY CONTRACT and that is now ENFORCED IN CODE, not merely declared. maxStreams/maxBatch/drainPolicy are purely DECLARATIVE in the compiled flow runtime - space_data_module_runtime_begin_node_invocation pops the node whole queue port-blind up to the drain budget (64) - so a node that read ordinal 0 of a port and returned used to destroy every other frame it was handed there, with nothing re-delivering them and nothing logging the loss (live P1 cellular-multiprovider-returns-only-first-provider). A surplus is now refused with error code "batched-input-frames", naming the port and the count. See graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames.
